keyParity: 100% - every key in en.json is present in hi.json
scope: Covers the i18n surface area used by the persistent UI chrome (nav, support panel, age attestation, declaration label, emergency labels). AS OF 2026-05-17: homepage marketing copy keys (home.*) have been scaffolded into both files but the Hindi values are EMPTY STRINGS pending a native-speaker translator. See docs/translation/hindi-marketing-handoff.md for the full inventory and policy. The remaining marketing pages - /how-it-works, /resources, /faq, /privacy, /terms, /start, /minor-support, victim flow, admin console - still render English-primary copy directly in JSX and do NOT pull from this dictionary yet.
notes: AI-drafted Hindi strings (for the persistent chrome keys) must NOT be marked production-ready until reviewed by a native Hindi speaker for trauma-informed tone, gender-inclusive verb forms, and legal-citation accuracy. The homepage marketing keys are intentionally empty - hi-review-status policy is that AI translation of survivor-facing marketing copy is unacceptable. A native Hindi speaker fills home.* values. Once translation rounds-trip, the engineer migrates the homepage JSX to read from t(locale, key) and scaffolds the next page batch.
policyOnGenderInclusiveForms: Verb forms use both feminine and masculine endings (e.g., 'करती/करता हूं') to avoid presuming the survivor's gender. Keep this pattern in future translations.
